truth: Unique exact match of the published oriented sequence in the supplied locus, both strands searched
localization: Same contig and strand, >=20 nt overlap and >=50% of the shorter interval
coverage: Maximum fraction of reference bases overlapped by a localized prediction
errors: Counted as non-detections in the fixed mapped denominator; also reported separately
precision: Not estimated: reference loci are not exhaustively annotated for alternative tracrRNAs
history: Initial exploratory run counters used a looser overlap rule. This final metric uniformly rescores retained predictions from every stage.
